$comment: Machine-readable circomspect triage for `npm run lint:circuits`. Each entry suppresses ONE finding: same rule, file path suffix, and `match` text on the flagged line. Unused entries fail the gate. Policy and rule references: circuits/CIRCOMSPECT.md.

suppressions.justification: Deliberate single-use dummy constraint (Semaphore signal-hash-square pattern): recipientSquare <== recipient * recipient exists only to put the public input `recipient` into an explicit quadratic constraint.
